pool_description: the three EOWRs in the bundle (AK-3 plus two distractor reports)

rows.evidence: Passage [gdr882_ak3_eowr#c0010] states that Well AK-3 was drilled to a vertical depth of 1,955 feet. Passage [gdr1295_56-32_eowr#c0006] states that Well 56-32 was drilled to a depth of 9,145 ft. Passage [gdr1153_68-32_eowr#c0005] states that Well 68-32 was drilled to a depth of 1,000 ft. Comparing these depths, Well 56-32 was drilled the deepest.

Passage [gdr882_ak3_eowr#c0005] states that Well AK-3 was drilled to a total depth of 1,955'. Passage [gdr1295_56-32_eowr#c0006] states that Well 56-32 was drilled to a depth of 9,145 ft. Passage [gdr1153_68-32_eowr#c0071] states that Well 68-32 had a wellbore depth of 5.70 (ft): --- and 5.500 at 1,000, but it is unclear if this refers to the total depth. However, passage [gdr1153_68-32_eowr#c0064] indicates that the well was planned to a total depth of 1,000 ft. and the actual depth is not explicitly stated, but the well was drilled to a depth of 1,000 ft. based on the context.

Passage [gdr882_ak3_eowr#c0010] states that 'Well AK-3 was spud on 18 August 2016'. Passage [gdr1295_56-32_eowr#c0016] mentions that 'Well 56-32 is the 5th well drilled in the Milford area Utah Frontier Observatory for Research in Geothermal Energy (FORGE) Enhanced Geothermal System (EGS) site (Utah FORGE)'. Passage [gdr1153_68-32_eowr#c0071] indicates that 'Rigging up on 78-32 well site' and 'Rig was 95% cleared off location at 18:00 hrs' on 12-Mar-19, which suggests that well 68-32 was spudded after AK-3 and 56-32.

Passage [gdr882_ak3_eowr#c0002] states that Well AK-3 was drilled to a vertical depth of 1,955 feet, which is deeper than the planned 1,700 feet. Passage [gdr1295_56-32_eowr#c0006] mentions that Well 56-32 was drilled to a depth of 9,145 ft., 145 ft. deeper than the planned depth of 9,000 ft. Passage [gdr1153_68-32_eowr#c0005] indicates that Well 68-32 was drilled to a depth of 1,000 ft., which matches the planned depth.

The provided passages do not mention any GRG geologist working on both the AK-3 well and the Utah FORGE monitoring wells. The only GRG geologists mentioned are Mary Mann and Dr. Pete Stelling, who worked on the AK-3 well, but there is no information about their involvement with the Utah FORGE monitoring wells.

Passage [gdr1295_56-32_eowr#c0003] states that 'Sami Atalay' is the Sr. Drilling Engineer who prepared the 56-32 end-of-well report. Passage [gdr1153_68-32_eowr#c0003] states that 'Ernesto Rivas' is the Senior Drilling Engineer (GRG) for the 68-32 end-of-well report.
All the provided passages are titled 'End of Well Report Utah FORGE Seismic Monitoring Well 56-32', indicating they are end-of-well reports for the same well. There are 10 such passages listed.

Passage [c0005] states that Well 68-32 is the shallow seismic monitoring well for the FORGE project and that it was drilled to host seismic monitoring instruments during injection in Well 58-32. This directly answers the question about which well's injection was monitored by Well 68-32.

Passage [gdr882_ak3_eowr#c0002] states that 'Akutan Well AK-3 well was drilled to a vertical depth of 1,955 feet in 27 days, in contrast to the planned 1,700 feet in 30 days, including rig-up and rig-down time.' This indicates the spud date for AK-3 was 18 August 2016. Passage [gdr1153_68-32_eowr#c0072] mentions 'Spud Date: 5.500 at 981 #10031' which is interpreted as the spud date for 68-32 being 9 March 19. Passage [gdr1295_56-32_eowr#c0006] states 'Well 56-32 was drilled to a depth of 9,145 ft.' and 'The drilling and testing of 56-32 well was completed deeper than planned, ahead of schedule
